name: NF P 03-001 — General Conditions for Private Construction Contracts
description: Validates tender and contract documents against NF P 03-001 (Cahier des clauses administratives applicable aux travaux de batiment faisant l'objet de marches prives). Checks that the CCAP covers essential clauses: price structure, payment terms, acceptance, defects liability (garantie de parfait achevement), retention, insurance, and dispute resolution. Applicable to private-sector building contracts in France.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
